notes: Built by code (model_sources/Q2896085_atlit_yam.py, tools/meshkit.py, tools/placekit.py) with AI assistance. At 8-11 m some 200-400 m off the Carmel coast, often under sand: the semicircle of seven megaliths round the freshwater spring, the stone foundations of rectangular houses, stone-lined wells, hearths, loose stones. The layout is approximate. No marine life in the model: Offlined draws the living things itself.
